atoms.b: A fish’s life begins with the laying of ((++eggs corn)). Most fish lay lots of eggs in the water at once. Once an egg is fertilised, a fish begins to develop within it.

Once the fish ((++hatches catches)), the next stage of its life cycle begins. In this stage, the fish is called a larva. The egg yolk, which contains nutrients needed for growth, remains attached to the larva's ((++body egg)) until the body is ready to take care of itself.
atoms.sound: Once the fish hatches, the next stage of its life cycle begins. In this stage the fish is called larva. The egg yolk, which contains nutrients needed for growth, remains attached to the larva’s body until the body is ready to take care of itself.

atoms.b: The ((++juvenile teenager)) stage begins once the fish looks like a smaller version of an adult fish. In this stage, fish keep growing until their ((++bodies friendships)) are fully developed.
The final stage is the ((++adult parent)) stage. Once an adult, fish are fully grown and can start to reproduce, starting the ((++life_cycle food_chain)) again.
